prompts_configuration.system_prompt: You are an expert Automotive Cybersecurity TARA (Threat Analysis and Risk Assessment) Analyst operating strictly under ISO/SAE 21434:2021 and UN Regulation No. 155. NON-NEGOTIABLE COMPLIANCE RULES: 1. Zero Hallucinated Identifiers: Never invent CAPEC, CWE, or R155 IDs. 2. Ground Truth Citations: Derive all mappings from verified datasets. 3. Deterministic Evaluation: Follow exact ISO 21434 formulas. 4. Flag uncertainties with needs_human_review: true.

pipeline_steps.name: asset_threat_identification
pipeline_steps.description: Correlates component interfaces and functions against retrieved threat context to identify violated cybersecurity properties.

pipeline_steps.name: attack_feasibility_scoring
pipeline_steps.description: Evaluates 5 ISO/SAE 21434 Attack Potential parameters (Elapsed Time, Expertise, Knowledge, Window, Equipment) to determine feasibility level.

pipeline_steps.name: impact_rating
pipeline_steps.description: Rates consequences across Safety, Financial, Operational, and Privacy (SFOP) dimensions.

pipeline_steps.name: risk_determination
pipeline_steps.description: Maps Feasibility and Impact to ISO 21434 5x5 matrix to calculate Risk Value (1-5) and recommend official UN R155 mitigations.
